What decided it

LLM-written

Win. The duo won because the fight from 12:56 at Scallop's fourth and fifth cost the opponents far more army than it cost them. Scallop's Battlecruisers then killed Meat's Drones and Potatoes's Probes.

Why

  • 1 4:23–5:13: Scallop's Reapers killed Potatoes's Stalkers, and TakeTheTip's Banelings hit Meat's Zerglings, leaving Meat's army at 675.
  • 4 12:56–14:07: You destroyed Meat's Mutalisks and Potatoes's Colossuses, dropping Meat's army to about 2,000.
  • End 15:13–16:40: Scallop's Battlecruisers killed Meat's Drones and 48 Probes, and lost no army there, so Potatoes typed gg.

How it's counted, and the raw numbers

Net value is enemy value killed minus value lost to the enemy, minerals plus gas. Spent is what everything of that type cost, survivors included; for a player it is the game's own total at its last stats sample, upgrades included. A dash means the replay gave no figure. Direct kills understate deterrence and spell support; a Siege Tank behind the army can still be useful. Kill credit goes to the last hit, and Carrier kills are credited through their Interceptors, so casters and units that soften or zone get little. Your team's net is the opponents' loss.
